Browne Amplification browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal Browne Amplification The Carbon - Overdrive Published on December 13, 2023 Browne Amplification overdrive pedal Information Browne Amplification The Carbon is the stand-alone Blue Side of the Protein Pedal. It is a heavily modified BB-style pedal that is half of the celebrated Protein Pedal found on pro boards all across the world. Simple in design and avoiding the complicated options that can be found in other pedals of the same circuit, the Carbon is a pedal you might never turn off. The V2 features an additional hi-cut toggle with 2 variations, along with the OG Carbon setting. Right = Subtle Cut Center = OG Carbon Left = More Cut.
